name: Midwest Ltd
title: Midwest Ltd - 544587 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Granite core steady at 27.6% EBITDA, but consolidated margin slipped to 27.0% as new Quartz plant runs at low utilisation; management targets 60% of 250-300kt capacity this year.

utilisation.quote: our endeavour is to reach at least 60% of the rated capacity this year

capex.quote: the capex is around INR130 crores, between INR125 crores and INR130 crores.

triggers.label: Quartz utilisation target 60% this year
triggers.quote: our endeavour is to reach at least 60% of the rated capacity this year

triggers.label: Working capital days 122 to 104
triggers.quote: working capital days we have reduced from 122 to 104 days

triggers.label: Export prices raised 4% for next year
triggers.quote: we've increased the prices this year for the coming year by 4%

triggers.label: Quartz Phase 2 capex INR125-130 crore
triggers.quote: the capex is around INR130 crores, between INR125 crores and INR130 crores.

guidance.quote: we'll be tracking that year-on-year growth of 10% to 11%, 12%.

guidance.value: at least 60% of rated capacity this year
guidance.quote: our endeavour is to reach at least 60% of the rated capacity this year

guidance.value: Q4 FY27, volumes from Q1 next year
guidance.quote: We have a plan to complete it in by Q4 of this year.

guidance.value: Quartz ~INR400 cr, HMS ~INR350-400 cr, KMML ~INR200 cr, granite ~INR1,000 cr
guidance.quote: you're looking at INR1,000 crores in granite, then about INR1,100 crores around that from these 3 projects

guidance.value: Mining licence post policy; plant build 9-12 months from August
guidance.quote: we can start building the plant as early as August post that. And it'll take about an year to build the plant

red_flags.label: Quartz plant losses dragging consolidated margin
red_flags.quote: This consolidated number of 16.49% is majorly on account of some cost which is arising on account of Quartz, which is around INR6 crores.

red_flags.label: Quartz Q4 sales only ~1,000 tonnes despite production
red_flags.quote: as far as sale is concerned, we did about 1,000 plus tons.

red_flags.label: Logistics shortfall left ~3,000 CBM unshipped
red_flags.quote: we couldn't ship out the goods to the tune of 3,000 plus CBM, which could have added revenue to the tune of INR25 crores.

evasions.quote: we're still doing some work on what the strategy is going to be
So, in terms of scale, right now there is -- as far as I know, there is they're just building out the plant right now.
